{{Quote|The Emperor commissioned artists across the Galaxy to emphasize the power of the Empire. The Empire hired me to give the painting to all citizens.|[[Navari Trik]] speaking of ''United in Our Cause''|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''''United in Our Cause''''' was the title of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] [[Painting/Legends|poster]] painted some [[Time/Legends|time]] during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. It was the winner of the [[Galactic Empire Painting Contest]]. Upon winning the contest, it was given out to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] by [[Navari Trik]].

==Depiction==
The painting depicted a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] crafter, identified as [[Ceric]], on the left side and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] entertainer, identified as [[Tails]], on the right side. A small battle taking place outside of an [[Forward Outpost|Imperial Forward Outpost]] could be seen depicted in the center of the painting. A group of three [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]], a [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout trooper]] and a [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Shocktrooper]] were also shown in a combative stance. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text in the center portion of the painting read, "United in Our Cause." Along the bottom of the painting, the text read, "Crafters, Fighters, Ents" (short for entertainers). The text was obviously alluding to the crafter, fighters and entertainer depicted above.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''United in Our Cause'' was a painting that players of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' could obtain for a limited time, from a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in Mos Eisley.<ref name="GU5">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67876&month=072008|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 5}}</ref> The painting was voted on by the players, barely winning against another painting titled ''A Day Long Remembered''. A third painting, simply titled ''Empire'' was also voted on, but it received the fewest votes.<ref name="Forums">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=688338|text=Create a Painting Contest - Imperial Finalists!}}</ref>

The painting was created by "Zel", a player of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' from the guild known as Mercs and Skilled Craftsmen, or MASC for short, of the Bloodfin server. Reportedly, the Mon Calamari crafter and the Twi'lek entertainer were the characters of two other players respectively known as "Ceric" and "Tails," also from the MASC guild. According to Zel, the two of them died, and he wished to memorialize them by including their player names in the painting.<ref name="MASC">{{WebCite|url=http://mascguild.com/faq.html|text=MASC FAQ|nobackup=1}}</ref>
